articles.summary: TORONTO, Canada – November 3, 2026 – Fury Gold Mines Limited (TSX and NYSE American: FURY) (“Fury” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce first assay results from its 2026 diamond drill program at the Committee Bay gold project (“Committee Bay” or the “Project”), located in the eastern Kitikmeot region of Nunavut.
